title: Reshape a product feed: split, rename, drop, filter and explode tags
objective_text: Manipulate columns and rows: add, split, rename and drop columns, filter rows and explode an array into rows.
scenario: Merchandising wants to report sales by product tag. The product feed puts brand and model in one column and all of a product's tags in one comma-separated string, keeps prices in cents and still carries discontinued products and a legacy code nobody reads. Build silver.product_tags with one row per product and tag.
engine_label: DuckDB's PySpark API on this PC (not Apache Spark)
starting_environment: A Delta table bronze.products (5 products) in the exercise folder and a starter answer.py.
required: brand and model come from full_name, split on |.
One row per product and tag, the tag trimmed and lower case; a product with no tags has no rows.
Write silver.product_tags with id (was product_id), brand, model, price, tag, so that running the code again leaves the same table.

expected.description: silver.product_tags has 6 rows: product 1 with new, outdoor and sale; product 2 with heavy; product 5 with kids and tools.

verifies: Your PySpark splits, renames, drops, filters and explodes to the right rows and columns, on the exercise data and on rows you haven't seen, on this PC.
Running it again leaves the same table.
does_not_verify: It doesn't run on Apache Spark or in a Databricks workspace, so it doesn't show Spark's own plan or how explode grows a large table.
hints: F.split(F.col("full_name"), "\\|") gives an array; F.element_at(arr, 1) is the brand and F.element_at(arr, 2) the model.
F.explode(F.split(F.col("tags"), ",")) gives one row per tag and no row for a NULL tags value; explode_outer would keep it.
Trim and lower-case each tag after exploding, then withColumnRenamed("product_id", "id") and select the five columns.
explanation: Filter out discontinued products, split full_name on an escaped | and take the two parts with element_at, turn cents into a decimal price, explode the split tags so each tag gets its own row (a product with NULL tags drops out, which explode_outer would keep as a NULL tag), trim and lower-case each tag, rename product_id to id, keep the five columns and overwrite the table.
troubleshooting: Tags like ' sale' and 'sale' both appear: trim after exploding, not before splitting.
A row with an empty tag: the code uses explode_outer, which keeps products with no tags.
Prices a hundred times too big: divide price_cents by 100 before the cast.
reset: Reset rebuilds bronze.products from setup.sql, removes silver.product_tags and puts the starter back.
cleanup: Everything lives in this exercise's folder on this PC; Reset or removing the exercise deletes it. Nothing is created in any workspace.
